Leo drinks milk after doing sports. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bank counter by bike. Life is full of small surprises. Also, clean the floor with a hard brush.
The bank counter is one of the best places in the city. Leo borrowed a book about art from the cinema. Leo learned a lot about art. What's more, the last mile of the hike was steeply uphill.
Ben is interested in dancing. They took many photos at the community center. Leo wants to be a teacher in the future.
